headline: Congress would bar AI chatbots for minors without limits
text:
Here is how your fear of AI is being used to centralize power today.

Congress would bar artificial intelligence chatbots from being offered to minors without age-based design limits. Not passed. It cites the fear that children are talking to chatbots.

381 measures in 48 jurisdictions would ban or restrict a use of AI, or make one a crime.

61 measures in 27 jurisdictions cite the fear that children are talking to chatbots.

2,239 measures tracked. 754 carry a control, and they would hand new power to 101 offices.
